harness.name: floci
harness.notes: GHCR image pinned by digest; live/floci-capabilities.json probes per-AWS-service coverage against it.

identity.description: the block address is a key of the marker map itself, beside tofu-estate

sweep.description: a Cloud Asset Inventory client built from the provider block's own credential arguments (Substrate.NewSweeper), one search per project the estate's resources name; the index lags creates and deletes

controller_held.mechanism: a Compute Engine instance or disk carrying a label key GKE, Dataproc or Batch reserves for the VMs and disks they create, or a Cloud Run service whose goog-managed-by label names a product; never a goog- prefix, which the provider writes on everything it creates

untaggable.definition: a google or google-beta 8.6.0 type whose schema carries no settable labels map beside effective_labels (live/readiness.json google.types, every tier but marker-carried)

rows.fence: Project-scoped, restated: an IAM condition cannot match a label, so one estate per project, granted by an ordinary project IAM binding. Resource Manager tag bindings, which a condition can match, are ruled later (#1121).

sweep.description: a cluster client built from the provider block's own connection arguments (Substrate.NewSweeper)

controller_held.mechanism: the object's Helm release annotation (kubesweep.HelmReleaseNameAnnotation), read off the object itself rather than off the label marker map
